title: Majestic Queen!!
reviewNotes: Montages, captions and native complete diagrams reviewed. Conditional final back-rank mate only, after Black takes the offered queen with a6xb5 at151 seconds. Native56 establishes the complete fifteen-piece diagram: White Kg1/Rd8/Nf1/e7/e3/f2/g2/h2 against Kh8/Qc1/Re8/b5/f6/g7/h7; native57/58 confirm Rxe8 mate. The captured piece on b5 is White’s queen, and the capturing pawn came from a6. Rxe8# has an exact finite certificate ending in actual mate with every remaining pawn retained. This does not prove that accepting the queen was forced, certify all defenses to Qxb5, or establish the earlier seventeen-piece Qd5/Kh8/queen-offer plan. The legal Qxf1+/Kxf1 refusal and its larger conversion remain explicitly outside this proof, with the earlier full legal draft preserved. The narrated resignation is not itself outcome evidence.
